summary.text: Dan Frankel is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 23 who has served since December 1, 1998 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Dan Frankel assumed office in the Pennsylvania House on December 1, 1998.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the Health Committee and served on the Rules Committee.
